description: The supplied image is not a scientific figure panel. It is the standard CrossMark publisher logo: a small square graphic on a pale grey/white background containing a circular arrow ring (segments in yellow-orange and teal-blue) that encircles a red ribbon/bookmark shape, with the two-line text "Check for updates" printed in dark grey beneath the ring. The icon is a low-resolution raster (roughly 150 x 150 px) with visible edge blur; the only legible text is "Check for updates" and there are no axes, no scale bar, no legend, no data points, no specimen labels and no quantitative content of any kind. No caption was extracted for this group, and the paper title and abstract concern near-rapidly solidified low-density Fe-20Mn-9Al-1.2C-xCr steel strips, Cr effects on δ-ferrite and κ-carbide, and tensile properties — none of which is depicted in this image. Consequently no scientific claim, trend or material system can be linked to this image, and it provides no usable evidence for microstructure, phase, processing or property information.
